2609.08475.title: Do Reviewers Still Reward Lexical Complexity? A Frozen-Rater Study of Preference Drift in 124K ICLR Reviews
2609.08475.paper_summary: Large language models have collapsed the cost of producing lexically elaborate prose, and whether peer reviewers still reward it is a question about the evaluator, not about the text. When the association between a writing cue and review scores moves across years, the reviewers may have changed, the submissions may have changed, or both, and a regression of scores on text cannot say which. We separate the two with a frozen rater: 81,850 machine reviews of ICLR submissions from 2018 to 2025, all generated in one February-April 2025 window with one model family and one prompt, so that its year-to-year coefficients track submission composition alone and the human-minus-frozen trend difference identifies reviewer preference drift. On 32,638 submissions with 124,615 human reviews, the human coefficient on non-domain lexical complexity falls from +0.142 to -0.015 while the frozen rater moves from +0.080 to +0.082; the three-way difference-in-differences is -0.0100 (q=0.013), and forty random-wordlist placebos through the same specification centre on zero. Humans still reward sentence-length variability, which the frozen rater never registers, while the frozen rater still pays for lexical complexity at its earlier rate. Every claim is held to a double gate of false-discovery control and interval exclusion, and the findings that failed adversarial re-testing are reported. Reviewers discounted a cue whose production cost collapsed, as models of manipulable signals prescribe; an LLM judge calibrated to historical human preferences inherits the earlier schedule and drifts out of alignment while its agreement with humans on totals stays ordinary.
2609.08475.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型已經降低了產生詞彙豐富的散文的成本，而同行評審是否仍然給予獎勵則是關於評估者的問題，而不是文本的問題。當寫作提示與評審分數之間的關聯在不同年份之間變化時，評審者可能已經改變，提交的作品可能已經改變，或者兩者都改變了，而對文本的分數回歸無法說明是哪一種。我們用一個固定的評審者來區分這兩者：81,850 次對 2018 至 2025 年 ICLR 提交的機器評審，全部在 2025 年 2 月至 4 月的一個窗口內生成，使用同一個模型家族和同一個提示，以便其年度係數僅追蹤提交組成，而人類與固定評審者的趨勢差異則識別評審者偏好的漂移。在 32,638 次提交和 124,615 次人類評審中，非領域詞彙複雜度的人類係數從 +0.142 降至 -0.015，而固定評審者則從 +0.080 移動至 +0.082；三方差異的差異為 -0.0100 (q=0.013)，而四十個隨機單詞列表的安慰劑在相同的規範下集中於零。人類仍然獎勵句子長度的變異性，而固定評審者從未記錄此點，同時固定評審者仍然以其早期的速度支付詞彙複雜度。每一項主張都受到虛假發現控制和區間排除的雙重檢查，而未能通過對抗性重新測試的發現將被報告。評審者對一個生產成本降低的提示給予了折扣，正如可操控信號的模型所規定；一個根據歷史人類偏好校準的 LLM 評審者繼承了早期的時間表並漂移出對齊，而其與人類在總數上的一致性保持普通。
2609.08475.author: Jiabin Zheng et.al.
